_doc: free-exercise-db muscle vocabulary -> JCV_<group> vertex groups baked by build_scene.py.
Source vocabulary: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db (Unlicense / public domain, JSON metadata only).
null = the mannequin has no honest vertex group for that muscle yet; render_exercise.py skips it with a log line.
abductors  - glute medius / TFL on the OUTER hip; the glutes group is carved facing backwards only
adductors  - inner thigh; the quads group is front-facing only
forearms   - no forearm vertex group baked
lower back - erector spinae at spine04/05; the lats group is restricted to the sides of the upper back (side_dot)
neck       - no neck vertex group baked
traps      - no traps group; deltoids covers only the shoulder caps
middle back -> lats: rhomboid/mid-trap region overlaps the lats group's spine02/03 band; closest visual region
